gap_candidates.missing_behavior: PermissionGuard and navigation visibility for ordinary query, history, and settings routes must match backend permissions and suppress unauthorized background requests.
gap_candidates.why: Admin route guards are well tested, but /, /ask, /history and /settings use AuthGuard only; Sidebar always exposes ordinary items while runtime APIs enforce query/history/admin permissions.
gap_candidates.level: Component route integration + authenticated API/browser permission matrix
gap_candidates.browser: Required: direct URLs and navigation for least-privilege users.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable sessions for users with one exact permission set each.
gap_candidates.backend: None; backend authorization is the reference contract.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Clear or identity-scope all cached user/session/history/admin/schema data on sign-in, sign-out failure, user switch, and role/permission change.
gap_candidates.why: The singleton QueryClient uses feature-only keys; sign-in invalidates currentUser while only successful sign-out clears the cache. Existing tests use one identity.
gap_candidates.browser: Required: switch users/roles in one browser and observe DOM/network/cache.
gap_candidates.isolation: Two disposable users with disjoint histories/roles/connections.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Enforce and communicate the current maximum question length on the primary Workspace prompt, including paste, keyboard and server-configured boundary behavior.
gap_candidates.why: Legacy QueryInput truncates at 2000 and has tests; the reachable primary PromptInput has no maxLength/counter and current matrix evidence treats the old test as coverage.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for paste/keyboard/double-submit at 1999/2000/2001 and configured non-default limit.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic prompts; never retain complete prompt text.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Deleting a session with an in-flight query must cancel work, suppress late UI results, clean locks/state, and keep Undo semantics coherent.
gap_candidates.why: Frontend fake-timer tests prove only delayed DELETE/Undo; backend deletion does not signal the in-flight task. P2-FR-058 evidence is therefore overstated.
gap_candidates.browser: Required with a controllable slow query and delete/undo/delete paths.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable session, Redis and controllable adapter/source.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Legacy and current retry/accept actions must retain the submitted connection, dialect, schema and policy while enforcing retry quotas and complete audit state.
gap_candidates.why: Frontend sends only attempt_id on accept/reject/regenerate. Existing mocked tests cannot reveal that the public backend reconstructs a legacy default service.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for MySQL/MSSQL submit then regenerate/reject/accept.
gap_candidates.isolation: Dedicated platform DB/Redis and three disposable sources.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Expose a role policy test client/action/result for POST /admin/roles/{id}/test-policy with safe accessible schema/filter allow-or-block feedback.
gap_candidates.why: P5-FR-136 and the runtime route exist, but caller search finds no frontend client, control, state or test. Policy-editor screenshots do not exercise the endpoint.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for allowed/blocked/invalid/sanitized preview in EN/AR.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable role/connection/schema; no production identifiers.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Role create/edit UI must enumerate and preserve admin.quotas.manage and admin.security.manage alongside the Phase 5 permission set.
gap_candidates.why: AVAILABLE_PERMISSIONS contains six older permissions and omits both Phase 6 permissions, although navigation/guards and backend permission enum use them.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for assigning/removing each permission and verifying next-login navigation/API access.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable custom role/user.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Block or safely merge role saves until full role detail/policies hydrate, and prove failed detail fetch cannot erase persisted policies.
gap_candidates.why: The editor is seeded from a summary lacking connection_policies and Save remains reachable while useAdminRole loads. The existing test waits for eventual detail before saving.
gap_candidates.browser: Required with delayed/failed detail response and immediate Save attempt.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable role with non-empty policies.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Use one current runtime OpenAPI source and regenerate all frontend operations, request/response/download/redirect types and expected error statuses without manual drift.
gap_candidates.why: The script consumes the 35-operation Phase 1 artifact while runtime exposes 60 application operations; custom inline clients/raw casts compensate and generated error unions omit current statuses.
gap_candidates.browser: Focused browser checks only after contract reconciliation.
gap_candidates.isolation: Deterministic backend app factory; no live services.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Rollback or refetch optimistic history/result deletion and show safe mutation/regenerate failures.
gap_candidates.why: Workspace removes cards before DELETE and swallows rejection; regenerate failures only remove loading. Tests assert request/removal, not rejection recovery.
gap_candidates.browser: Helpful for focus/announcement and retry recovery.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic accepted results.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Wire each reachable ConnectionErrorCard CTA to an applicable select/manage/retry/recovery action or render it non-interactively.
gap_candidates.why: Workspace renders action buttons for connection error kinds but passes no onAction handler; tests assert labels only.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for reachable handler/navigation and focus.
gap_candidates.isolation: Mock each safe connection error category.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Implement and test the full ARIA listbox keyboard/focus model for the database selector.
gap_candidates.why: Roles are present and mouse clicks work, but Arrow/Home/End/Escape/typeahead/focus-return behavior is absent; screenshots cannot prove it.
gap_candidates.browser: Required at desktop, 768 and 375 in EN/AR.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic connection list.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Complete dialog, toast, focus restoration, nested-interactive and live-region semantics for destructive and timed actions.
gap_candidates.why: Functional click tests dominate; the custom connection-delete overlay is not a dialog, session items nest a button, and multiple toasts/statuses are plain visual text.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for focus trap/restore, Escape, Undo and route transitions.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic admin/session data.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Handle clipboard denial, lazy-highlighter failure and related console/unhandled rejections with safe accessible recovery and cleanup.
gap_candidates.why: Happy clipboard/import paths are tested; failures are silently ignored or logged, and no global error boundary captures rejected lazy work.
gap_candidates.level: Component failure injection + browser runtime console audit
gap_candidates.browser: Required for clipboard permission and unhandled-rejection observation.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic SQL with no production data.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Make history filtering cover the declared history set, place list errors correctly, and expose rows with valid interactive/table semantics.
gap_candidates.why: Filtering is local to fetched pages; list errors are rendered in the detail pane; row divs have key handlers but no interactive role and hidden columnheaders sit outside a table.
gap_candidates.level: Component + API pagination integration + browser accessibility
gap_candidates.browser: Required for multi-page filtering and keyboard/focus behavior.
gap_candidates.isolation: Seed multiple pages for one disposable user.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Validate custom/raw API payloads and define visible initial/background/empty/partial/malformed/error/retry states across pages.
gap_candidates.why: Most custom clients cast unknown data; only retention validates shape. Several pages can throw on malformed timestamps/dimensions or show stale/empty UI without a refresh indicator.
gap_candidates.level: Schema/contract unit tests + component fault matrix
gap_candidates.browser: Focused malformed/partial/stale recovery checks.
gap_candidates.isolation: MSW fixtures derived from current runtime schemas.
gap_candidates.chunk: FE-CHUNK-16 response validation and async states

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Export exactly the applied visible audit filters, honor/validate server filename metadata, and cover Blob/download cancellation and real file safety.
gap_candidates.why: The page intentionally exports unsent form values, constructs its own filename, ignores Content-Disposition and relies on mocked Blob content while backend-only tests prove redaction/formula safety.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for CSV/JSON filenames, applied filters, cancel/retry and file inspection.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable sanitized audit entries and downloads.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Align PolicyEditor row-filter validation with the backend sqlglot grammar and role-filter contract.
gap_candidates.why: The client checks comment markers and dangerous keywords against the raw string before stripping quoted literals. It can reject backend-valid literals containing tokens such as from or --, while the backend parser distinguishes quoted text and comments.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for representative valid/invalid expressions in EN/AR chrome.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic schema and identity placeholders.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Define atomic or resumable role/group-mapping create/update behavior with idempotent recovery and accurate user feedback.
gap_candidates.why: Role POST/PUT commits before parallel mapping calls. A mapping failure reports the whole operation failed even though the role may already exist or be changed.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for retry/cancel state after partial failure.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable role and group mappings.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Define route loading/error boundaries, deep-link/back-forward/reload behavior, async unmount cancellation and late-result suppression.
gap_candidates.why: Routes are eager with no error boundary; wildcard and URL draft behavior lack direct tests; fetches/timers/lazy promises can settle after navigation.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for direct URLs, back/forward, reload, unmount and unknown paths.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic slow/error responses.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Define and lock locale selection precedence/persistence, support language variants, and format dynamic dates/numbers with the active app locale.
gap_candidates.why: The configured detector lookup order excludes localStorage and production has no changeLanguage caller; App compares language exactly to ar; several toLocaleString calls omit i18n.language. Static key parity does not cover these runtime boundaries.
gap_candidates.browser: Required across reload and en/ar/ar-EG with date/time content.
gap_candidates.isolation: Fixed timestamps and browser locale overrides.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Complete required/default/null/server-rejected/secret-preserving/reset/cancel/dirty/double-submit/keyboard behavior and accessible error association for all forms.
gap_candidates.why: Happy validation and secret omission are strong, but form suites do not cover the complete boundary set and many errors are visually adjacent only.
gap_candidates.level: Component form matrix + focused browser keyboard
gap_candidates.browser: Required for focus/error announcement and double submission.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic safe values; never retain secrets.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Prove finite [0,1] threshold enforcement through native form constraints and handler/server paths in addition to block > flag, with safe reset/dirty/server-rejection recovery.
gap_candidates.why: Number inputs declare min/max, but the handler checks parseability and ordering rather than range. Existing component tests do not exercise native invalid submission or every server-rejection path, and the response shape is raw-cast.
gap_candidates.browser: Helpful for synchronized range/number keyboard, native validity and error semantics.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic threshold values.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Provide the declared result pagination and an explicit zero-row state in the primary workspace without losing result actions or table semantics.
gap_candidates.why: Current chat ResultTable renders every returned row and an empty tbody; legacy ResultTable has a no-results message. P1-FR-014/029 matrix status is broader than current primary UI assertions.
gap_candidates.browser: Required at desktop, 768 and 375 with wide/long data.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic bounded rows.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Reconcile Vitest/MSW/Playwright fixtures with runtime contracts, make assertions observe the named state, isolate generated artifacts and classify all mocks/skips explicitly.
gap_candidates.why: Stale permissions/shapes remain; the i18n error helper reloads before scanning; several hook tests assert only function existence; screenshot specs overwrite tracked evidence; browser API behavior is mostly mocked.
gap_candidates.level: Static harness audit + focused contract tests
gap_candidates.browser: Required only for corrected browser assertions; no screenshot updates during audit.
gap_candidates.isolation: Temporary output directories and schema-derived fixtures.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Add request cancellation/timeout/download abort semantics and prove no late state update, duplicate side effect or unhandled rejection after unmount.
gap_candidates.why: Generated/custom clients receive no AbortSignal or client timeout; UI pending refs prevent only same-hook overlap. Timeout evidence is mostly a mocked response.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for navigation/unmount/download cancellation.
gap_candidates.isolation: Controllable delayed HTTP responses.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Render distinct accessible auth/provider loading, empty, failure and sign-out recovery states without leaking raw IdP/network detail.
gap_candidates.why: Sanitized mapped errors are strong, but provider fetch errors, empty-password/double-submit and rejected sign-out are not comprehensively surfaced.
gap_candidates.level: Component/MSW auth state matrix + focused browser
gap_candidates.browser: Helpful for redirects/focus/live announcements.
gap_candidates.isolation: Mock IdP and synthetic users; no tokens retained.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Decide and test the supported status of the reachable but unlinked /ask legacy route, including redirects/bookmarks and contract parity with the workspace.
gap_candidates.why: Direct URL works and many old tests depend on it, while navigation uses /. Maintaining two decision UIs creates divergent connection, length, action and responsive behavior.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for direct URL/bookmark/back-forward once disposition is decided.
gap_candidates.isolation: No special isolation.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Set branded/localized document titles and lock deployed frontend/proxy security and cache-header ownership with a production-like check.
gap_candidates.why: index.html title is generic and no test covers title changes; nginx/backend header ownership is undocumented and backend inventory has the parallel header gap.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for title/history and final response headers.
gap_candidates.isolation: Production-like nginx/backend configuration.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Cover dynamic, long-label, error, dialog, table, toolbar, pagination, download and security-action layouts at desktop, 768 and 375 without relying on screenshots alone.
gap_candidates.why: Representative EN/AR screenshots and bounding-box tests exist, but multiple specs only capture images and do not assert overflow/reachability for every critical state.
gap_candidates.browser: Required at all three widths and both directions.
gap_candidates.isolation: Temporary screenshot/output directory; synthetic data.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Bound and paginate session/detail collections and prove large-session rendering remains responsive and cancellable.
gap_candidates.why: The frontend requests and renders all sessions/attempts; existing fixtures are small and current backend collection endpoints are unbounded.
gap_candidates.browser: Required with high-cardinality sessions/attempts at desktop/mobile.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic platform DB/session data.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Represent quota write responses that can fail after the durable database mutation, so retry/reload communicates actual state without duplicating user intent.
gap_candidates.why: Backend quota PUT/DELETE commits before Redis cache refresh and can return 503 after the durable change. Frontend shows a generic failure and cannot tell whether Save/Reset already took effect.
gap_candidates.browser: Required for save/reset failure, reload and idempotent retry messaging.
gap_candidates.isolation: Disposable quota role, PostgreSQL and Redis fault injection.

gap_candidates.missing_behavior: Prove that credentials, tokens/cookies, complete prompts, raw hostile input and provider/database/error internals never enter browser-observable DOM, accessibility text, console, storage/cache, rendered error text or downloaded files.
gap_candidates.why: Backend/unit and mocked DOM redaction checks cover many cases, but screenshots do not inspect these channels and no real-browser test jointly covers hostile/error/download flows plus same-browser identity switching.
gap_candidates.level: Security browser instrumentation + real API integration
gap_candidates.browser: Required with DOM/accessibility, console, storage/cache, rendered response and downloaded-file inspection.
gap_candidates.isolation: Synthetic canary secrets/prompts and disposable sessions; never retain complete prompts, credentials, cookies or tokens.
